empty.title: No data sources yet
empty.description: Add a file or a link with + to fill this design's layers from its rows.

source.unknownType: This source comes from "{type}", which isn't installed here.
source.needsKey: Needs a key on this device
source.needsKeyHint: This device doesn't have every key this source needs. Type them here to update it.
source.secretPending: Will be saved on this device
source.removeMessage: Undo brings the source back, but the keys saved on this device for it are deleted.

table.title: Rows
table.empty: No rows yet. Update the source to read its data.

fields.title: Fields
fields.empty: No fields yet. Update the source to find them.
fields.listOfItems_one: A list · {count} field in each item
fields.listOfItems_other: A list · {count} fields in each item
fields.innerNote: Each row has its own {name}. Fill these by repeating a card inside the main card.

errors.noFormat: Couldn't tell the data's format. Choose one under Format.
errors.pickFileAgain: Pick the file again on this device.
errors.privateFile: This file is in the app's own data folder, which data sources can't read.
errors.webPage: The source answered a web page, not data. Check the link, or whether it needs a key.
errors.pickFolderAgain: Pick the folder again on this device.
errors.privateFolder: This folder is in the app's own data folder, which data sources can't read.
errors.noLayer: This frame has no layer to repeat: add one to it first.
errors.noParentFrame: Put the layer inside a frame first.
errors.noList: There's no list at "{path}" in the data any more. Pick where the rows come from again.

images.failed_one: {count} image couldn't be saved in the file
images.failed_other: {count} images couldn't be saved in the file
images.failedOverLimit_one: {count} image couldn't be saved in the file ({over} past the limit of {limit} new images per Update: update again for the rest)
images.failedOverLimit_other: {count} images couldn't be saved in the file ({over} past the limit of {limit} new images per Update: update again for the rest)

section.title: Data
section.noSources: Add a source in the Data tab to fill this layer from its rows.
section.failed: Couldn't bind the layer to data

text.hint: Insert fields with the button; each one shows the row's value. Turning this on made any {example} already in the text a field.

repeat.title: Repeat
repeat.hint: Choose the card, then a list: the card shows once for each row, lined up by this frame's auto layout.
repeat.noLayer: Add a layer to this frame to repeat it as a card.
repeat.noLists: There's no list to repeat yet. Add a source in the Data tab.
repeat.copied: This frame is a copy another repeat made. Edit the template's repeat instead.

card.label: Card
card.hint: Shows this layer once for each row of a list. {frame} holds the copies; when it gets an auto layout for them, its other layers are lined up too.
card.switchKeeps: {card} then stays as a normal layer, and its data fields read nothing until you bind them again.

copy.title: Repeated copy
copy.rowHidden: A row of {source} not shown now
copy.badge: A copy for one row of {source}
copy.detachHint: Makes this copy plain layers you can edit. Until then it follows its template, and a deleted copy comes back.
copy.inRepeatedCard: This repeat is inside a repeated card, so its copies show in every copy of that card. Detach the outer copy instead.

kind.textOverflow: The text doesn't fit its box ({detail} px)
kind.detachedRowGone: Detached copies whose row is gone from the list: {detail}
kind.neverUpdated: Never updated: press Update to read its rows
kind.tooManyCopies: {detail} copies are made while designing: lower that limit
kind.copiesStacked: {detail} copies stack on top of each other: give the frame an auto layout

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Where this data comes from and what Cloudy Canvas sends to get it.
connection.badLink: This isn't a full link yet. It should start with https://
connection.getHint: GET reads data. Most links use it.
connection.postHint: POST sends the body, then reads what the site answers.
connection.makePrivate: Keep this value on this device

summary.post: Send {body} to {where}{tail}, then read the answer.

auth.apikey: signing in with your API key
auth.bearer: signing in with your access token
auth.basic: signing in with your username and password

params.intro: Options written at the end of the link, like how many items to get. Changing them here changes the link, and the other way round.
params.name: Setting

auth.intro: Does this site need to know who you are? Most public data doesn't.

apikey.label: API key
apikey.hint: A code the site gave you

auth.noneHint: Nothing extra is sent. If Try it says the site won't let you in, pick one of the others.
auth.apiKeyInHint: The site's guide says which one. Usually a header.
auth.secretNote: Kept on this device, never saved in the file, and sent only to {host}.

headers.intro: Extra details sent with the request. Pick a common one or type your own; values with the lock stay on this device.
headers.name: Header

headerHints.accept: What kind of answer you want back
headerHints.contentType: What kind of body you send
headerHints.authorization: Who you are (easier in the Sign in tab)
headerHints.apiKey: An API key some sites ask for
headerHints.cacheControl: Always get fresh data, not a stored copy
headerHints.userAgent: Who is asking (a few sites require it)

body.getNote: A GET request only reads, so it sends no body. Switch to POST to send something with it.
body.noneHint: Nothing is sent. Pick Form or JSON if the site expects something.
body.nested: This JSON has nested parts: keep editing it as code

try.title: Try it
try.idle: Run it to see the rows this link gives, before you save.
try.notAllowed: The site says you're not allowed in
